name: Beef Skirt Steak
siboNotes: Plain beef is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Marinate with low-FODMAP herbs like oregano, thyme, and chives
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Cook quickly over high heat for 2-3 minutes per side for optimal tenderness
Slice against the grain to reduce toughness
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
